final: WITH group_averages AS (SELECT e.ordersmark AS original_order_reference, o.timespan AS time_in_force, AVG(e.fillcount) AS average_units_filled FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY e.ordersmark COLLATE BINARY, o.timespan COLLATE BINARY), time_in_force_averages AS (SELECT time_in_force, AVG(average_units_filled) AS time_in_force_average FROM group_averages GROUP BY time_in_force COLLATE BINARY), ranked AS (SELECT g.original_order_reference, g.time_in_force, g.average_units_filled, g.average_units_filled - t.time_in_force_average AS average_difference, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY g.time_in_force ORDER BY g.average_units_filled DESC NULLS LAST) AS group_rank FROM group_averages AS g JOIN time_in_force_averages AS t ON g.time_in_force = t.time_in_force COLLATE BINARY WHERE g.average_units_filled > t.time_in_force_average) SELECT original_order_reference, time_in_force, average_units_filled, average_difference, group_rank FROM ranked WHERE group_rank <= 3
